g.text: SOF LLEXT Build, Link & Packaging Pipeline
From C Source and TOML Header to Relocatable ELF Linking, Rimage Signing (-l), and UUID Deployment Symlinks
Modules compile with zero static dependencies on unexported internals; Rimage validates binary layout against platform TOML.
The resulting container encapsulates an Extended Manifest (.xman), CSE directory, CSS signature, module descriptor table, and relocatable ELF segments.
